{{Hatnote|This page documents a constructed card pool. Official tournament documents remain authoritative.}}
'''Premiere &ndash; Theed Palace''' (display name '''Premiere - Theed Palace'''; GEMP environment name '''Decipher Cards Only''', code <code>open_no_virtual</code>) is a constructed environment whose legal pool is the printed Decipher sets from [[Premiere]] through [[Theed Palace]].

On [https://play.swccg.com/ play.swccg.com] and the Players Committee GEMP table this pool is listed as '''Decipher Cards Only''' (sets 1&ndash;14 plus the premium/reflections ids GEMP maps into that environment). It does '''not''' include Players Committee Virtual Sets.

The [[2022 Decipher Cards Only Retro Event]] was played in this format. Do not confuse it with [[Premiere - Reflections III]], which is the 2001 Decipher Worlds pool (Premiere through Reflections III only). Do not confuse it with [[Premiere - Original VS3]], which is this same printed pool plus original Virtual Sets 1–3 (the [[2002 World Championship]]).
